scope: Historical selected native counters for attribution, with original raw manifests preserved. Matching profiles identify bounded browser IPC retention; current application-storage findings are recorded in viewport-scoped-memory-summary.json. Missing counters remain null. Timings are excluded from latency acceptance; idle controls are attribution only. Selected counters alone do not prove an allocation owner.

manifest.scope: Private all-owned-target GC and native allocator and retained-heap study with explicit collection checkpoints; latency acceptance and uninterrupted natural peak come from the separate normal cohort. Every transition waits for complete persisted source, syntax and current geometry. Explicit collection at checkpoints; these timings are excluded from latency acceptance. Uninterrupted natural peaks come from the normal no-GC cohort. Five-cycle smoke does not establish sustained-memory behavior. Production single-input fields retain their original observation; memoryCycles and memoryAfterCycles describe the repeated-edit cohort.

candidateManifest.scope: Viewport candidate; consult the separate verification receipt for complete-source CI status. Complete-row HTML reuse preserves CSS-only wrapping, bounded fragments require current source/syntax/glyph ownership, and warm wrapped preparations coalesce through a task. Original recovery transport. Native device and new hosted checks remain pending.

counterDefinitions.allocatedObjectsBytes: Exact malloc/allocated_objects.size: live native allocation bytes, not reserved malloc capacity.
counterDefinitions.blinkLiveBytes: Exact blink_gc/main/heap.allocated_objects_size: live objects, not heap capacity.
counterDefinitions.directMappings: Exact allocated_objects_size and slot_size for each numbered direct mapping. Dump names do not persistently identify allocations.
counterDefinitions.blobStorageContainerBytes: Missing parent size remains null; actual per-context blob_count and disk_usage counters are preserved in blobStorageLeaves.
